Headline: Checkout API outage after config push
What happened: A config change raised connection pool size beyond database limits. Checkout failed for 47 minutes.
Cause: Config change skipped staged rollout because it was labelled low risk.
Fix: Rolled back config; added canary stage for all config changes.
Lesson: Treat config like code: stage it, canary it, and make rollback one click.

Headline: Expired TLS certificate takes down partner API
What happened: The certificate for the partner API expired on a Sunday. Partners could not connect for 5 hours.
Cause: Renewal was manual and the reminder went to an engineer who had left.
Fix: Automated renewal and added expiry monitoring 30 days ahead.
Lesson: Automate renewals and never tie alerts to one person.

Headline: Disk full on logging cluster drops audit logs
What happened: A verbose debug flag left on in production filled the logging disks. Audit logs were lost for 2 hours.
Cause: No alert on disk growth rate, only on 95 percent full.
Fix: Deleted debug logs, added growth rate alert, blocked debug flags in production.
Lesson: Alert on trends, not just thresholds.

Headline: Database migration locks orders table
What happened: A schema migration added an index without the concurrent option and locked the orders table for 12 minutes at peak.
Cause: Migration review did not check lock behavior; ran during business hours.
Fix: Migration checklist with lock analysis; migrations only in low traffic windows.
Lesson: Review migrations for locking and run them off peak.

Headline: Third party payment provider outage
What happened: Payment provider had a regional outage. We had no fallback and lost card payments for 90 minutes.
Cause: Single payment provider with no failover design.
Fix: Integrated a second provider with automatic failover.
Lesson: Critical external dependencies need a tested fallback.
Metrics: Payment success rate; revenue at risk

Headline: On call engineer could not access runbook during outage
What happened: The runbook for the search cluster was on a wiki that was down in the same outage.
Cause: Runbooks hosted on infrastructure that depends on the failing system.
Fix: Mirrored runbooks to a separate static site and printed copies for the NOC.
Lesson: Keep recovery docs outside the blast radius.
